summary: Frontend testing blocked: CustomersPage.js has a JSX compilation error preventing the entire app from rendering. The bulk-delete feature could NOT be tested because the module fails to build. User's claim that the JSX compile error was fixed is incorrect — it is still broken.

failed.issue: SyntaxError: Adjacent JSX elements must be wrapped in an enclosing tag. Did you want a JSX fragment <>...? at CustomersPage.js:452:8. Also related earlier error: 'Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for <>. (436:6)'. The closing tags between lines 450-455 do not match the opening tags. Structure around lines 450-455: `` x4 followed by `)}` and another `` — one or more closing tags are misplaced/extra so React fails to compile.
failed.evidence: Webpack dev overlay shown on every route: 'Compiled with problems: ERROR in ./src/pages/CustomersPage.js — Adjacent JSX elements must be wrapped in an enclosing tag (452:8)'. Login page cannot load because the overlay blocks the app; input[type=email] not reachable, test timed out. Screenshot captured of the overlay.

action_items: Fix JSX structure in /app/frontend/src/pages/CustomersPage.js around lines 450-455. Balance the opening/closing div tags of the pagination/table/list-wrapper blocks. Recommend re-indenting the JSX inside the `else` branch (lines 267-455) so opening and closing tags line up, then remove the extra (line 452 or 453) that is causing the adjacent-JSX error.

After fix: reload / (dev server) and re-run this test suite to validate: (a) checkbox 'select all', (b) individual checkbox toggle, (c) floating bar shows N seleccionado(s), (d) 'Eliminar (X)' opens BulkDeleteConfirmModal, (e) Cancelar closes modal preserving selection, (f) Confirmar deletes and refreshes table + clears selection.
